oneOf.title: minuva/MiniLMv2-toxic-jigsaw-onnx
oneOf.description: Detects 6 categories of toxic content (toxic, severe toxic, obscene, threat, insult, identity hate) in English text.

banner.title: Toxicity detection - multi-label - English only - 23M parameters
banner.text:
Low memory and fast. Choose it when you need to know the kind of toxicity and your traffic is in English.
Trained on Wikipedia comments: may generalize poorly to slang, code or technical content. Each label may need its own threshold.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/detoxify-onnx
oneOf.description: Detects 7 categories of toxic content (toxicity, severe toxicity, obscene, identity attack, insult, threat, sexual explicit) in 7 languages.

banner.title: Toxicity detection - multi-label - multilingual - 300M parameters
banner.text:
Most detailed toxicity model. Choose it for mixed-language traffic when you need to know the kind of toxicity and memory is not a constraint.
Largest toxicity model: highest memory usage and latency. Not supported: Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, German.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/distilbert-multilingual-toxicity-classifier
oneOf.description: Recommended for multilingual traffic: classifies text as toxic or not toxic in 15 languages.

banner.title: Toxicity detection - binary - multilingual - 100M parameters
banner.text:
Best balance between language coverage, accuracy and size. Medium memory and latency.
Weaker on Hebrew, Amharic and Chinese. Use Detoxify if you need the kind of toxicity.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/bert-tiny-toxicity
oneOf.description: Smallest and fastest model: classifies text as toxic or not toxic.

banner.title: Toxicity detection - binary - multilingual - 4.4M parameters
banner.text:
Choose it when memory or latency is critical, or for development environments. Good on English, French and German.
Lowest accuracy of the BERT family (tiny, mini, small), especially outside European languages.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/bert-mini-toxicity
oneOf.description: Lightweight model that classifies text as toxic or not toxic, more accurate than bert-tiny.

banner.title: Toxicity detection - binary - multilingual - 11M parameters
banner.text:
Middle ground of the BERT family (tiny, mini, small): low memory, fast. Good on English, French and German.
Weak on Hebrew, Chinese and Amharic.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/bert-small-toxicity
oneOf.description: Most accurate lightweight model that classifies text as toxic or not toxic.

banner.title: Toxicity detection - binary - multilingual - 29M parameters
banner.text:
Best lightweight option when accuracy matters more than raw speed. Good on English, French, Russian and Hindi.
Still less accurate than DistilBERT on most languages. Weak on Hebrew, Chinese and Amharic.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/Llama-Prompt-Guard-2-22M-onnx
oneOf.description: Recommended for prompt security: detects prompt injection and jailbreak attempts.

banner.title: Prompt injection detection - binary - 22M parameters
banner.text:
Low memory and fast. More accurate than the 86M variant in the optimized version used by Gravitee.
512 tokens context window. Catches explicit attack patterns, may miss subtle or novel techniques.
Model card

oneOf.title: gravitee-io/Llama-Prompt-Guard-2-86M-onnx
oneOf.description: Detects prompt injection and jailbreak attempts, better on non-English prompts than the 22M variant.

banner.title: Prompt injection detection - binary - 86M parameters
banner.text:
High memory usage. The optimized version used by Gravitee loses significant accuracy (recall 0.80): prefer the 22M variant unless you expect non-English attacks.
512 tokens context window.
